working_title: AI Traffic Rules: Shared Natural-Language Rules for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Collaboration
research_question: Does placing shared natural-language rules in a common external layer reduce coordination friction, interpretation differences, and unsafe or conflicting actions across heterogeneous AI agents?
core_claim: A shared rule layer may function like traffic rules: it can define boundaries and escalation conditions while preserving freedom of action inside those boundaries.
known_prior_work: Governance and coordination research for LLM agents
